Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: Identifies beginning of new message and protocol version. Always the first field in the message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Message length, in bytes, forward to the CheckSum field. Always the second field in the message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Defines message type. Always the third field in the message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Assigned value used to identify the firm sending the message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Assigned value used to identify the receiving firm. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Integer message sequence number. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time of message transmission, always expressed in UTC. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Modulo 256 checksum of all characters in message up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum field. Three digits with leading zeroes if necessary. Always the last field in the message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Monitors the status of the communication link and identifies when the last of a string of messages was not received.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: TestRequest
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Forces a heartbeat from the opposing application.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier included in the Test Request message to be returned in the resulting Heartbeat. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: ResendRequest
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Initiates the retransmission of messages.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent; 0 for infinity. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Reject
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Issued when a message is received but cannot be properly processed due to a session-level rule violation.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: The tag number of the FIX field being referenced. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message being referenced. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Where possible, message to explain reason for rejection. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: SequenceReset
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Gap Fill mode skips administrative or application messages that will not be resent; Reset mode re-establishes the sequence number.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates that the Sequence Reset message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Logout
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Initiates or confirms the termination of a FIX session.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Authenticates a user establishing a connection to a remote system; the first message sent by the application requesting to initiate a FIX session.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Method of encryption. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval, in seconds. FIX 4.2 standard field.
